name: What is a realistic budget for a 4,000 to 6,000 square foot luxury home?

mainEntity.name: How much should I expect to spend on a mid- to large-size luxury custom home in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: How much should I expect to spend on a mid- to large-size luxury custom home in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Square footage alone does not determine the budget for a luxury home. The same size house can vary substantially based on lot slope, foundation type, architecture, materials, glazing, custom millwork, and systems like automation or advanced HVAC. A 4,000 to 6,000 square foot luxury home on a simple site with a modest high-end finish package will cost far less than a similar house on a hillside with premium materials and custom detailing throughout. Homeowners should use square footage only as a rough starting point and then refine the budget based on site constraints and finish goals. An itemized feasibility budget is far more useful than a generic per-square-foot estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: A 4,000 to 6,000 square foot luxury home can vary widely in price depending on lot conditions, finish level, and specialty systems. The same size home can land in very different budget ranges if it is flat-lot versus hillside or moderately finished versus ultra-luxury.
